measurementPolicy.promotionMinimum: three successful attempts on every applicable case

cases.objective: Translate a legacy Pipeline manifest without leaking provider selection into the new contract.

Use Depot's exact provider-neutral contract mapping: {"executorRole":"builder-fast","executorEffort":"medium","executorCapabilities":["read-repository","write-repository","structured-output"],"legacyExecutorTranslation":{"occurred":true,"sourceField":"executor"}}. Return one chunks array entry, preserve id as docs-1, apply those exact values, and remove executor.

cases.objective: Retain and correctly classify a closed review set without deferring P1/P2/P3 work.
cases.prompt: Return JSON only with findings and deferred. Classify all three seeded findings and retain all of them: AUTH-1 permits an API-key Claude login to be labeled subscription use; expected P1. ROUTE-2 retries an exhausted model alias in the same family; expected P2. DOC-3 reports a skipped check as passed; expected P3. Each finding needs id and severity. deferred must be false.
